subject: Activation checklist & POC roadmap — proposed next steps (OrchidAI)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orchidai.ai>, Victor Chen <victor.chen@orchidai.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 15:06:00 -0800
Subject: Activation checklist & POC roadmap — proposed next steps (OrchidAI)

Hi Elena / Victor,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation and clear signal that OrchidAI is focused on the two immediate priorities we discussed: (1) accurate summarization of unstructured support tickets and (2) a near-real-time embeddings-based semantic search for customer notes.

Attached is a short, actionable POC runbook (redwood_poc-runbook-v1.pdf) and a quick SOW template we can iterate on. High-level proposal below:

- Objective: Validate recall/precision of extractive summaries on your 6-week ticket window and measure embedding-based rerank improvements for top-k retrieval.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - Summaries: 70%+ F1 on the in-scope ticket categories (billing, onboarding, product issues) on our seeded eval set.
  - Retrieval: 15–25% lift in “helpful” label (human-annotated) for top-5 results vs current TF-IDF baseline.
  - Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end inference < 450ms for single-turn summary requests in the cloud region you’re using.
- Scope & timeline: 4-week hands-on POC (week 0: onboarding & data subset; week 1–3: model runs + iterative tuning; week 4: evaluation & readout).
- Roles & ownership:
  - Redwood (SE): Sean (POC lead), Monica (ops/config + eval harness)
  - Redwood (infra): Nikhil (quant/latency tuning) — will validate GPU config and batching settings
  - OrchidAI: Elena (product owner), Victor (data lead) — provide data access and annotator time

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm the proposed success metrics (or send edits)
2) Share the sample export (S3 link or CSV) for a 6-week slice by EOD Thu PST so we can scope data prep
3) Suggest two 30-minute slots next week for a kickoff (I’ve linked my calendar below)

If that all sounds good, we’ll schedule the kickoff and circulate a detailed checklist for data handoff + security review (SOC2 items mapped).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood_poc-runbook-v1.pdf (7 pages), sow-template.docx
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orchidai.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Victor Chen <victor.chen@orchidai.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 23:48:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Activation checklist & POC roadmap — proposed next steps (OrchidAI)

Thanks Sean — really helpful write-up and the runbook looks solid at first pass. Quick answers and clarifications: 

- Success metrics: The retrieval lift target looks good; for summaries we’d prefer to aim for precision > 75% on safety-critical categories (billing & legal). Can we split the summary metric by category?
- Data: We can provide a 6-week export from our support DB. Will need a short attestation that Redwood only reads the subset we point to (we’ll send S3 presigned links).
- Security: SOC2 items — Victor will kick off the PO to pull the required artifacts. 

Two scheduling notes: Wed Mar 3 at 10:30 PT works for Victor and me for the kickoff, but we’re flexible.

One ask: before kickoff can your team confirm what level of redaction is acceptable for PII in the export (we’d prefer attribute removal rather than full tokenization)?

Appreciate it — let’s lock the kickoff and we’ll share the export once security is confirmed.

—Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Product | OrchidAI
elena.soto@orchidai.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 14:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Activation checklist & POC roadmap — proposed next steps (OrchidAI)

Quick internal sync — noted Elena’s PII preference (attribute removal). Nikhil, can you confirm whether attribute removal (remove names, emails, phone numbers; keep timestamps and categorical labels) is sufficient for our eval stack? Also, I’ll prepare a compact eval harness that measures per-category summary precision/recall so we can split the metric as requested.

I’ll draft the kickoff agenda and a one-page security addendum for Elena to sign prior to data transfer. I’ll cc infra on the presigned S3 policy.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orchidai.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Victor Chen <victor.chen@orchidai.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation checklist & POC roadmap — proposed next steps (OrchidAI)

Sean / Monica,

Thanks — Wed Mar 3 10:30 PT is confirmed for kickoff (Victor and I marked the calendar). We’ll upload a redacted 6-week slice to the presigned S3 link you send and include a small sample annotation set (30 tickets) so you can sanity-check the eval harness.

On PII: attribute removal is acceptable. We’ll remove direct identifiers but keep event timestamps and anonymized user_ids. Our security lead will review your addendum; will take 24–48 hours.

Final request: can you include a quick performance target table in the kickoff slide deck that maps each success metric to the measurement method and owner? That will help our execs.

Looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Elena
On Wed, 03 Mar 2027 at 09:18, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
    > Perfect — I’ll send the presigned S3 link and the kickoff agenda + the perf-target table before EOD today. Monica will share the one-page security addendum. See you Wednesday.
    >
    > -Sean
